title: Section-size bound for the affine etale generator
statement: For every scheme X in universe u and every U in the opposite of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], the underlying type of the abelian section group G_X(U) of the concretely constructed sheaf [def-sc-etale-small-generator] is u-small.

source.place: Sheafified free abelian representables; see also Tag 03EW (3) and Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Generator.Sheaf.

proof.text: On the u-small model C, each free abelian representable presheaf is a coproduct of lifted integers indexed by a u-small hom set, hence the coefficient lift of its u-valued version. Compute sheafification by applying the plus construction twice: matching-family limits have u-small index types, and the filtered partially ordered set of covering sieves is u-small. Coefficient lifting preserves these limits and colimits, so it commutes with sheafification. The coproduct indexed by C times Unit likewise commutes with lifting, because lifting preserves coproducts and sheafification is a left adjoint. Thus every section group of the constructed coproduct on C is u-small. Uniqueness of sheafification and of coproducts identifies these computations with the particular choices used in G_X.

The small-model comparison transfers the section bound to affine etale objects. Cover any etale object U by its affine open subschemes, indexed by a u-small subset of its opens. Separatedness of the transported sheaf injects its sections on U into the product of its section groups on that covering. Each factor is u-small, the index is u-small, and a type injecting into a u-small product is u-small. This handles non-quasi-compact U as well as empty U (empty product, hence singleton sections).
